selected_evidence.requirement: datauser is limited to 100 MB under /srv/data by the filesystem
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the dedicated XFS mount with usrquota, accounting and enforcement ON, 102400-block/100M soft and hard limits, and a write rejected at exactly 104,857,600 bytes.

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota configuration and data persist after restart
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, the mount unit is active, XFS quota enforcement remains ON with 100M limits, the sentinel checksum is unchanged, and another over-limit write is rejected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel are retained
selected_evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-restart checks report AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e was captured, the safe restart was acknowledged, the new boot ID 180b2953-5c3d-4dd7-8457-caec69c3c186 proves restart, and post-restart mount, quota, data, and system health checks passed.

commands.command:
set -eu
id datauser >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd --no-create-home --shell /bin/bash datauser
install -d -m 0750 -o datauser -g datauser /srv/data
if [ ! -f /var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs ]; then
  fallocate -l 512M /var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs
  chmod 0600 /var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs
  mkfs.xfs -f -L DATAUSER /var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs
fi
if ! grep -Fq '/var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs /srv/data xfs' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' '/var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs /srv/data xfs loop,usrquota,nofail 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
mountpoint -q /srv/data || mount /srv/data
chown datauser:datauser /srv/data
chmod 0750 /srv/data
printf 'USER='; id datauser
printf 'MOUNT='; findmnt -T /srv/data -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS,TARGET
printf 'FSTAB='; grep -F '/var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs /srv/data xfs' /etc/fstab
printf 'LABEL='; xfs_admin -l /var/lib/datauser-storage.xfs

set -u

  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: over-limit write unexpectedly succeeded'
  exit 1

xfs_quota -x -c 'report -ubh' /srv/data
rm -f /srv/data/quota-enforcement-test
sync

xfs_quota -x -c 'report -ubh' /srv/data
